_comment: Upstream changelog entries already triaged, keyed by release, scope and a digest of the entry. The sentences themselves are deliberately not stored: primeng.dev content is outside the MIT grant (CONTRIBUTING.md), so this file records OUR decisions, not their prose. Regenerate with: npm run watch:upstream -- --record

22.1.0 · Table · 9f85f9a516a5.note: REPRODUCES, and the mechanism is not the one first suspected. Measured in the browser 2026-09-04 (e2e/upstream-repro.spec.ts, held as test.fail): with rows=2, shrinking both the data and the declared totalRecords from 5 to 2 leaves the paginator rendering 3 pages. Cause is NOT clear(): onChanges() at table.ts:1200 copies the totalRecords input into _totalRecords only when simpleChange.totalRecords.firstChange is true, so every later change is dropped, and :1212 then overwrites the freshly-set input with the stale _totalRecords. clear() at :2209 repeats the same expression, so it inherits the staleness rather than causing it. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1. The earlier note asked that this not be closed by reasoning; it was closed by measurement.

22.1.0 · Table · 3ae212c58d45.note: REPRODUCES, and wider than upstream states it. ButtonProps declares outlined? (types/button/button.types.ts:114) but button.ts never reads buttonProps?.outlined — every other prop uses the `x || buttonProps?.x` pattern. So outlined is ignored on EVERY agl-button, not just this one; the table additionally hard-codes [outlined]="true" on the clear button. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1.

22.1.0 · Table · 0c9d548f166c.note: DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Measured in the browser 2026-09-04 (e2e/upstream-repro.spec.ts, ordinary passing test): with the body scrolled sideways, document.elementFromPoint over the frozen cell returns the frozen cell. The test asserts its own premise first — scrollLeft > 0, and a normal cell geometrically extending under the frozen column x-range — so a green result cannot come from nothing being underneath. The library contributes no z-index here; stacking comes from the theme CSS, which is why source could not answer it. Test kept as a regression guard.

22.1.0 · Table · d9c2f7aacdad.note: DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Measured in the browser 2026-09-04 (e2e/upstream-repro.spec.ts, ordinary passing test): filter to one row, call clear(), and both things the mechanism predicted would break are fine — all three rows return AND the column filter input is empty. The in-place filter.value = null at table.ts:2213-2223 is real and hasFilter() does stay true, but neither consequence reaches the user here. Note also that the notEquals half of the earlier reasoning is moot: that defect was fixed under the first P3 exemption (filterservice.ts, 2026-08-26). Test kept as a regression guard.

22.1.0 · DatePicker · b3d68c790b2d.note: REPRODUCES. Measured in the browser 2026-09-04 (e2e/upstream-repro.spec.ts, held as test.fail): with minDate and the value both at 09:00 on the same day, one step down renders 11, not 09. The locus is the switch(true) at datepicker.ts:2733 whose body is a hard-coded returnTimeTriple[0] = 11 plus this.pm = true; :2727 hard-codes 11 the same way. Inherited verbatim from 21.1.9. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1. Earlier note said "exact trigger not yet reproduced" — it is now.

22.1.0 · Select · fff76133ad6e.note: NOT OURS. angulux select has no `multiple` input — that property exists only in their v22. Nothing here can enter the state described.

22.1.0 · FilterService · 2d7b393e4c46.note: REPRODUCES. Proven at runtime against the BUILT package: FilterService.filter with an empty filter returns 0/3 rows for notEquals and 3/3 for equals/startsWith/contains/notContains (null, undefined and "" alike). filterservice.ts:101-103 returns false where every sibling returns true. isNot delegates to it and is fixed by the same line; dateIsNot carries its own guard and was NEVER affected — the first triage said otherwise and was wrong. Reachable from the UI: executeLocalFilter (table.ts:2142) has no blank guard, and columnFilter registers constraints with value: null. Fix changes runtime behaviour: blocked by P3 in Phase 1.

22.1.0 · Chart · e4168e282a3c.note: DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Type-checked the built dist (chart + table + api) under strict:true, skipLibCheck:false with the workspace TypeScript: exit 0. Their defect is in their v22 types.

22.1.0 · Menu · 1cba7aee156a.note: Not actionable. No locus, no reproduction steps, and their issue tracker is archived. Reopen only if the same shape is reported against angulux.
